description: Predict Chinese multimodal leaderboard metrics across VLM parameter scales.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are Art Style, Forensic Detection, Functional Correspondence, IQ Test, Jigsaw, Multi-view Reasoning, and 176 more.
